gloss: scenic spot; place of scenic beauty

definitions.gloss: scenic spot; place of scenic beauty
definitions.explanation: A location renowned for its beautiful natural scenery. Often used for officially recognized or well-known tourist destinations featuring natural landscapes.

examples.japanese: ⟦ここ→ここ：00961_koko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{景勝地|けいしょうち}だ。
examples.english: This is a famous scenic spot.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{景勝地|けいしょうち}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japan has many places of scenic beauty.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{湖|みずうみ}→湖：00867_mizuumi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{国|くに}→国：02204_kuni⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{名勝|めいしょう}→名勝：12059_meishou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{景勝地|けいしょうち}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: This lake is known as a scenic spot designated as a national place of scenic beauty.

notes:
A somewhat formal word used in travel writing, tourism, and official designations. It emphasizes natural beauty rather than historical or cultural significance.

FORMS:
{景勝|けいしょう} (scenic beauty) + {地|ち} (place)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {景勝地|けいしょうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{巡|めぐ}る→巡る：03930_meguru⟧: to tour scenic spots
- ⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{景勝地|けいしょうち}: a famous scenic spot
- {景勝地|けいしょうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{指定|してい}→指定：00373_shitei⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to be designated a scenic area
- ⟦{自然|しぜん}→自然：01423_shizen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{景勝地|けいしょうち}: a natural scenic spot

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{名所|めいしょ}→名所：08164_meisho⟧: famous place — broader, includes historical and cultural sites as well as scenic ones
- ⟦{絶景|ぜっけい}→絶景：16835_zekkei⟧: breathtaking view — describes the view itself, not the location
- ⟦{名勝|めいしょう}→名勝：12059_meishou⟧: scenic site — an official designation for nationally protected scenic places; more formal and administrative
